high_level_description: This image depicts a futuristic, floating pyramid structure set against a dramatic sky during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. The pyramid is composed of multiple reflective layers, each showing a mirrored image of the cityscape below it. The lower part of the pyramid is partially submerged in clouds, creating an ethereal and surreal effect. The cityscape below the pyramid is modern and densely populated with tall skyscrapers, some of which are illuminated, suggesting that it is either dusk or dawn.
